The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the special season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[Pokémon Chronicles]], in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}). ==Super Wallets== {{main|Super Wallet}} {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing [[Super Wallet]]s to celebrate the {{pkmn|10th Anniversary}}.
